THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE1_EPOCH.title: Never Love an Anchor
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE1_EPOCH.description:
[aqua]"I keep waiting for you to be the man I need. It's time we both admit that's never going to happen."[/aqua]

It wasn't fair to either of them. Nothing ever had been.

She didn't know about [color=db5ee2]the egg[/color]. She didn't know [color=B18AFF]he[/color] would be gone by the time it was laid. But she was the one stuck with the consequences. When had it ever been any different?
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE1_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Killed|Kill} [blue]15[/blue] [red]Bosses[/red] with the [color=db5ee2]Wildfire[/color]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE2_EPOCH.title: Soul on Fire
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE2_EPOCH.description:
The first fire wasn't on purpose. Or the second, or the third. How could they be? She was barely [color=db5ee2]two years old[/color]. But fire is fire, and a village can only take so much.

[orange]"Get that thing out of here before it kills us all!"
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE2_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Played|Play} a run with the [color=db5ee2]Wildfire[/color]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE3_EPOCH.title: Mother Pray for Me
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE3_EPOCH.description:
[color=db5ee2]The girl[/color] had never seen such a large building before. Or so many strange, featherless people all dressed up in [gold]robes[/gold].

[aqua]"You're sure we can stay here?"[/aqua]

[gold]"You ask like I'm making a decision. But there's no decision to make. Someone has to teach her."[/gold]
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE3_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] with the [color=db5ee2]Wildfire[/color]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE4_EPOCH.title: Claim Your True Feelings, Wounded Child
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE4_EPOCH.description:
[gold]"Breathe in, and breathe out."[/gold]

[color=db5ee2]"I'm trying! It doesn't [jitter]WORK[/jitter]!"[/color]

[gold]"You're getting upset. And that is okay. But you must remain in control, even when you're angry. Now. Breathe in, and breathe out."[/gold]

[sine][color=db5ee2]hhhhhaaaah... huhhhhhhhhhhhh...[/color][/sine]
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE4_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] with the [color=db5ee2]Wildfire[/color]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE5_EPOCH.title: Scars
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE5_EPOCH.description:
She never knew [red]her father[/red]. But she felt [red]him[/red] in her soul.

The fire, the anger, the magic that ruined her life. It didn't come from [aqua]her mother[/aqua]. It came from [red]him[/red]. The two-bit [color=B18AFF]sorcerer[/color] who left her to carry it alone.

If [red]he's[/red] anything like the voice she hears inside herself... [red]he's[/red] earned the piece of her mind [red]he's[/red] gonna get and then some.
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE5_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Killed|Kill} [blue]15[/blue] [purple]Elites[/purple] with the [color=db5ee2]Wildfire[/color]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE6_EPOCH.title: I Didn't Come Here to Surrender
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE6_EPOCH.description:
[color=db5ee2]"Abbess, please. I'm not a kid anymore. I can handle the same jobs as anyone else."[/color]

[gold]"You'd be wasted on most of them. But you're right. You're a grown woman now, and it's time we started treating you like it. So... how would you feel about a visit to[/gold] [blue]The Capital[/blue][gold]?"[/gold]
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE6_EPOCH.unlock:
The [color=db5ee2]Wildfire[/color] burns anew.
[red]Ascensions[/red] are available when starting a run.
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE6_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]3[/blue] with the [color=db5ee2]Wildfire[/color]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE7_EPOCH.title: Try Honesty
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE7_EPOCH.description:
Deep within the [gold]Spire[/gold], a demon takes keen interest in the [color=db5ee2]Wildfire[/color]'s plight.

"You know, that [color=B18AFF]'pop'[/color] of yours might not be as far away as you think. I could help you find [jitter]him[/jitter] with just a little spark of that [color=db5ee2]sorcery[/color]. You got more than you know what to do with, don'tcha?"

For a moment, the [color=db5ee2]Wildfire[/color] is tempted. But something inside her is too proud to accept.

[color=db5ee2]"Sorry. But this fire is mine. I'm the one who has to control it. And that means I can't give it away."[/color]
THEWILDFIRE-WILDFIRE7_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [red]Ascension[/red] [blue]1[/blue] with the [color=db5ee2]Wildfire[/color]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
